_comment: Briscola locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action token '[play X]', the card labels (A, 2..7, J, Q, K), the suit symbols (carried in the {card}/{trump_card} slots), or numeric counts/points/scores. The '(TRUMP)' marker text may be localized.

_slots.{trump_suit}: The trump suit symbol (♠♥♦♣) - do not translate
_slots.{trump_card}: The trump card label, e.g. '7♠' - do not translate
_slots.{card}: A card label, e.g. 'A♥' - do not translate
_slots.{max_pos}: The highest legal card position in the player's hand
_slots.{count}: The number of cards a player holds
_slots.{pos}: A card's position number in the hand
_slots.{points}: A number of points (card value or accumulated score)
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered score line, or the final per-player score block
_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick or game
_slots.{tricks}: A number of tricks won by a player
_slots.{deck_count}: Number of cards left in the deck

game.start: Briscola ta'alafaga amata! Suiti Trump: {trump_suit} (Kaata Trump: {trump_card})

prompt.intro:
E ta'aalo Briscola - Tagata ta'aalo {player_id}.
Fa'amoemoe: Manumalo i tricks ma maua puna tele (120 puna i totonu o le deck).
Puna o Kaata: A=11, 3=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2, isi=0
Malia o Kaata: A > 3 > K > Q > J > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 2
Kaata Trump e fa'aleagaina kaata leai o Trump pe a lelei.

Gaoioiga: '[play X]' i le fa'ai'uga X o le nofoaga (1-{max_pos}) o le kaata i lou lima

hand.empty: E leai ni kata i le lima.
hand.trump_mark: (TRUMP) O le mea moni, o loo iai se isi auala e mafai ona faia ai faapea.

trick.empty: E leai se pepa e taaalo ai i lenei togafiti.

turn.trump_info_deck: Suiti Trump: {trump_suit} | Kaata toeititi i totonu o le deck: {deck_count}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Faaaoga le [play X] pe afai o X, e faasino i tulaga (1, 2, 3, ma isi mea faapena) o se kata.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nofoaga kaata leaga. E {count} kaata sau (1-{count})

action.trick_win: Tagata ta'aalo {winner} manumalo i le trick ma {card} ma maua {points} puna!
